summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a related-party transaction with Petrobras, expanding its commercial credit limit from R$350 million to R$2.35 billion for feedstock purchases. The transaction, effective through December 31, 2026, includes fiduciary guarantees such as receivable assignments and escrow account arrangements. It was reviewed by the Statutory Compliance & Audit and Finance & Investment Committees, approved by the Board of Directors, and assessed under Braskem's Related Party Transactions Policy. This is a routine credit facility disclosure, not a special situation. What to watch: any covenant breaches or credit limit suspensions might signal financial stress.
